target_customer: High school families paying for online coding classes (Juni Learning), later SAT and ACT prep (Acely AI tutor)
problem: Kids lacked access to quality live instruction in coding and later test prep; Acely applies AI tutoring to the digital SAT and ACT.
business_model: Consumer subscription for live online classes (Juni) and AI tutor subscription (Acely)
product_category: Education, online tutoring and AI test prep

founders.name: Vivian Shen
founders.role: Co-founder and CEO of Juni Learning
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page for Acely, which lists her as founder.

competitors.name: VIPKid
competitors.what: Online one on one tutoring marketplace focused on English instruction
competitors.traction_then: Large scale online tutoring player cited by TechCrunch as contrast: Juni teaches programming

technical_complexity.rationale: Juni needed a marketplace and scheduling platform plus curriculum; Acely adds AI tutoring on top of existing LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Curriculum and instructor network give some edge, but online tutoring is easy to enter. Moat type brand is my own label.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. Juni later spun out an AI tutor product, Acely, launched out of beta in January 2024.

market_need_then: Parents wanted structured coding classes for kids in 2018; demand for online learning rose sharply in 2020 according to Forerunner's quote in the Series A coverage.

branding.community_and_virality: Named Overall College Prep Company of the Year in the 2025 EdTech Breakthrough Awards (PRWeb release).

brand_strength.rationale: Award and growing consumer use, but the brand is new and tied to the Juni parent; name origin not sourced.

pivots.from: Live online coding classes for kids (Juni Learning)
pivots.to: AI tutor for digital SAT and ACT (Acely) as a spinout product
pivots.why: The YC page says Acely launched out of beta in January 2024 as a spinout from Juni.

outcome_analysis: This YC W18 record is the Juni Learning company, whose product Acely became an AI SAT and ACT tutor. Juni raised an angel round in 2018 and a 10.5 million Series A in 2020 and, per the YC description, Acely reached about 10 million dollars in ARR with a small team by 2025. The shift from live classes to AI tutoring looks like the main success driver.
notes: Company name in the directory is Acely but the W18 batch refers to Juni Learning. A $22M July 2021 Series A on one data site conflicts with the $10.5M Series A of 2020 and is unverified. Ruby Lee is named co-founder in one secondary source only, so not listed. The $10M ARR figure is self reported. Forerunner appears as an investor in the 2020 round; a 2026 release says Forerunner recruited a new CEO. Search results for the 2018 round came from a Fortune and EdSurge snippet; the amount came from the search summary of EdSurge.
